prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished portrait mobile game screen concept for CAR WARS, 1024 x 2048 aspect approximately 1:2, edge-to-edge screenshot, no phone device frame. Screen: main menu with role selection. The supplied image is a visual reference for the existing game's car silhouettes, elevated camera, simplified city geometry and sunny palette, not an edit target.
Art direction: delightful chunky low-poly miniature 3D city; clean matte beveled cars; yellow getaway sedan with dark navy windows, white and dark navy police sedan with red-blue rooftop lightbar. Simple peach, warm cream and sky-blue building masses with blue roofs and NO facade windows. Warm sunlight, blue fill, slate blue asphalt, cream road markings. Clear strong forms, playful arcade chase energy, no grim atmosphere. Sophisticated restrained mobile UI with navy ink, pale cream rounded cards, blue cop accent, gold thief accent; consistent bold rounded Cyrillic sans-serif text, generous safe-area margins, clean hierarchy.
Composition: top centered large two-line logo "CAR WARS"; below exactly "Выбери свою сторону". Middle hero miniature city intersection with the white/navy police car and golden-yellow getaway car diagonally opposed as two equal choices, simple curving tire tracks on pavement, believable scale. Lower half has two equally prominent stacked wide selection cards: first shows a police car thumbnail and large "КОП", subtitle "Поймай угонщика", small blue badge icon, blue button "ИГРАТЬ ЗА КОПА"; second shows yellow car thumbnail and large "УГОНЩИК", subtitle "Уйди от погони", small tire icon, golden button "ИГРАТЬ ЗА УГОНЩИКА". Each choice must read instantly. Bottom small settings gear and "Настройки". All text exactly as quoted, Cyrillic, crisp legible typography.
Constraints: ONE screen only, no contact sheet, no human characters, no weapons, no currency, no shop, no extra menu options, no device frame, no watermark, no faux developer labels. This is visual concept art for a future screen, not a capture of existing implemented functionality.
